title: Fig. 23: GT-4 primary/secondary landing zones and recovery forces world map; Fig. 24
description: World map titled "GT-4 PRIMARY AND SECONDARY LANDING ZONES, RECOVERY SHIP SUPPORT AND CONTINGENCY RESCUE FORCES" marking recovery areas, carrier, destroyer and oiler positions and contingency rescue force bases such as San Diego, Kindley, Lajes, Las Palmas, Ascension, Okinawa, Hickam and Perth. Below it, Fig. 24 is a diagram titled "RECOVERY AREA FORCES" showing a 480-mile-diameter primary recovery zone, a 200 by 40 mile landing footprint ellipse, ARS aircraft 250 miles out, and the USS Wasp and one destroyer at the touchdown point.
